Generate a NEXUS File with an Embedded MrBayes Block

prepare_mrbayes_nexus.Rd

Sanitizes sequence labels, writes a DNAbin alignment to a NEXUS file, appends a generated MrBayes block, and returns the output file path.

Usage

prepare_mrbayes_nexus(
  alignment,
  output_path,
  mcmc_options = NULL,
  partition = T,
  loci_length,
  loci_name,
  protein_coding_loci,
  lset_options,
  prset_options = NULL,
  sum_options = NULL
)

Arguments

alignment

A DNAbin alignment object.

output_path

Character. Output file path (with or without a .nexus extension).

mcmc_options

Named list or NULL. Arguments passed to mrbayes_mcmc_cmd(). Default is NULL.

partition

Logical. Whether to include a partition scheme generated by mrbayes_partition_cmd(). Default is TRUE.

loci_length

Numeric vector. Length of each locus, passed to mrbayes_partition_cmd().

loci_name

Character vector. Name of each locus, passed to mrbayes_partition_cmd().

protein_coding_loci

Character vector. Names of protein-coding loci, passed to mrbayes_partition_cmd().

lset_options

Named list or list of named lists. Arguments passed to mrbayes_lset_cmd().

prset_options

Named list, list of named lists, or NULL. Arguments passed to mrbayes_prset_cmd(). Default is NULL.

sum_options

Named list, list of named lists, or NULL. Arguments passed to mrbayes_sum_cmd(). Default is NULL.

Value

Character path to the written NEXUS file.

See also

mrbayes

Other mrbayes: mrbayes
